atomic_cutover: Remove HTTP production imports of Delivery notification and PWA applications, and its internal-test notification import. HTTP declares independent DTOs/error identities; root translates the public Delivery device/consent contract. Existing services expose that contract through typed adapters, preserving diagnostics, original causes, nil results and nil-versus-empty slices. PWA remains a structurally compatible scalar port. Locale validation is bound through the same Delivery consent facade to the existing locale catalog. No route, response, transaction, session or permission change. One public package classification; no rule, alias, grant, checker or budget change. No compose LOC growth.

Root contract tests check real owner-to-public-to-consumer error causes/diagnostics, nil wiring and preference JSON including nil and allocated-empty lists.
Source lint, immutable-base architecture/evidence checks and complete non-fast test-changed are required before push.
